snippet.title: Shienryu (紫炎龍) 2-ALL
snippet.description:
Shienryu 2-ALL final score 50.786.980

Shienryu (紫炎龍) ("purple flame dragon") is a vertical scrolling shooter created by Warashi for the arcade and released in 1997. You can choose the ship in 1p side (Red) or 2p side (Blue), it have different pilots and colors, but the same properties. Your ship starts with the Vulcam-type shot and slowest movement. Along the way you can collect items that give you points, increase your speed or change your ship's shooting properties. These items become available after destroying certain enemies and can be of the following types:
Power up (P): Increases ship’s firepower. If the item is collected when weapon power is full, player gets 5.000 points. You start at power level 0 and can go up to power level 3. For power level 1, you need to grab 1 P. For power level 2, you need to grab 2 more Ps (total of 3 ). For level 3, you need to grab 3 more Ps (total of 6). You're able to grab 3 more Ps after this until you start getting 5.000 points bonuses for grabbing additional Ps. Pick those three additional Ps once you are already at level 3 makes your shot change aspect and shot frequency but not sure if it will make it anymore strong. Before moving on to the next level, you can see how many Ps you have taken by looking at the small Ps under your life supply (in the upper left corner of the screen). If you have at least one P there, you will return to level 1 when you get hit and not to 0.
Speed up (S): Increases fighter's speed (up to 3 times).
Bomb (B): Increases player's bomb stock (up to 20).  
Full power & shield (flashing P): increases fighter's firepower to maximum and gives to fighter a Shield whch will become it invulnerable until it being hit once. The center part of your ship will change color (to gray) while the shield is active. If your ship’s firepower is at maximum at moment you collect the Purple P, it will explode in an array of items which include bombs, Speeds, shot changes and power ups.
Change Vulcan (red): Changes weapon to vulcan. 
Change Laser (blue): Changes weapon to laser. 
Change Missile (yellow): Changes weapon to missile.
Red LED: Increase player's score by 500 points.
Blue LED: Increase player's score by 5.000 points.
1UP: Increases player's life stock by 1. This is a rare item during runs, but you always get it when you defeat the Midboss in the sixth stage.
2UP: Increases player's life stock by 2. This is by far the rarest item in the game.
The game has two loops with eight stages each. In 2nd loop there are more enemies in screen and the bullets are fired at faster speeds. When a player loses a life, the game continues at the last reached pre-defined checkpoint with firepower at level 1 or 0 (depending on whether or not you have a P in stock) at slowest speed. The checkpoint feature is inactive when a second player is present.
You will earn your first extend with 1.5 million points and after every 2 million points reached. Shienryu's main feature is its extremely aggressive rank system. The rank will progressively increase during the game as long as you don't lose lives. But certain attitudes can make the rank rise faster. These actions include increasing firepower, collecting surplus P or S items, and carrying a high stock of bombs. Catching a purple when already while at a high firepower level or collecting more than 10 bombs seems to have the biggest impacts on rank. The game can become unplayable with these attitudes, dying helps to reduce the rank, but the rank will never return to the level it was before and will keep unplayable.
The score system consists of killing enemies with the blue weapon, not dying, collecting leds or surplus items (at the cost of increasing rank) during the phases. Killing the last boss (Shienryu) with blue weapon will give you 10 million points instead of 1 million and has the biggest impact on your score. At the end of each stage, player gets 5000 points for each available bomb, 500 points for each red LED collected in the completed stage (blue LED counts as 10 red LEDs). Collect surplus P, B, S or your current ship's change weapon items gives you 5.000. After completing the two loops you will earn 1 million points for each life left.
